noticeTitle: Belgium – Research and experimental development services – EU Complementary Time (C-T) and Complementary Position and Navigation (C-PN) services
procedureTitle: EU Complementary Time (C-T) and Complementary Position and Navigation (C-PN) services
description: Satellite-based navigation and timing services are a cornerstone of Europe’s economy and critical infrastructure resilience. Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT) functions, delivered principally by Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) such as the EU owned Galileo, underpin sectors ranging from transport and finance to energy and telecommunications. Several studies attribute roughly 10 % of EU GDP to PNT related activities, while a single day without GNSS could have a financial impact up to €1 billion. The Commission proposal for the European Competitiveness Fund (ECF), includes for the 2028‑2034 Multi‑annual Financial Framework, a contribution to complementary PNT services, which shall increase the resilience in case of disruptions to the services provided by the PNT component (Article 59). The project shall assess how best can the Commission contribute to complementary PNT services in the next MFF. Leveraging existing national and pan‑European infrastructure, the Commission would like to assess: • How to best strengthen with the resilience of PNT services to radio frequency interference (RFI) affecting GNSS services throughout the EU. • How to best contribute to the deployment of a mature, interoperable C T architecture that is ready for operational use within the multi financial framework 2028 2034. • How to best support candidates for a C-PN service, that utilise the C-T infrastructure and are resilient to RFI and to assess whether the technology is ready for deployment or, if not what is required.

buyerDepartment: DEFIS.E - Space Policy, Satellite Navigation and Earth Observation

noticeTitle: Belgium – Research consultancy services – EU space Data (Galileo and Copernicus) Integration to support fisheries control
procedureTitle: EU space Data (Galileo and Copernicus) Integration to support fisheries control
description: This procurment implements a Pilot Project.The pilot project will define minimum technical, operational and regulatory requirements for the integration of EU Space data (Galileo and Copernicus) to support fisheries control. Currently there are no standards and no regulations for the use of GNSS (e.g. Galileo authentication) and Copernicus services (SAR and optical images) to be used for law enforcement. The project will contribute to the work of European Committees for drawing up standards in the field of fisheries control.

procedureTitle: Procurement(s) of future Galileo Ground Segment activities
description: The European Space Agency (hereinafter referred to as “the Agency” or “ESA”) acting in its role as Entrusted Entity in the name and on behalf of the European Commission (Commission or COM) - Contracting Authority, representing the European Union is planning to launch the relevant tender procedure(s) for the procurement(s) of future Galileo Ground Segment activities, including specific actions to further increase the robustness of the Public Regulated Service Full Operational Capability (PRS FOC). noticeTitle: Belgium – Research and development consultancy services – Fused PNT Analyses based on European Infrastructure
procedureTitle: Fused PNT Analyses based on European Infrastructure
description: The European Commission is launching a study on the potential use of communication-oriented LEO constellations for the deployment of a complementary PNT service. This approach is normally referred to as Fused PNT. This tender will focus on developing a user terminal prototype and a simulated environment enabling to assess the performance of Fused PNT under a realistic set of propagation conditions and inter-satellite interference. In this procurement, the main goals of the European Commission are: • To develop a software receiver, supporting acquisition and tracking of 3GPP reference signals for Non-terrestrial networks (NTN) • To model multipath channel and intersatellite interference, in order to test the software receiver under the realistic satellite based propagation channel and interferences; • To consolidate and complement the part of the E2E emulator, by adding multipath and intersatellite interference models; • To demonstrate the performance of fused PNT ranging in a representative simulated environment • To validate the acquisition and tracking performance in realistic environment.

noticeTitle: Belgium – Research and development services and related consultancy services – MultilaYer LEO Extended GNSS (MYLE-GNSS) end-to-end simulator supporting multi-service integrity analysis
procedureTitle: MultilaYer LEO Extended GNSS (MYLE-GNSS) end-to-end simulator supporting multi-service integrity analysis
description: Objective 1: to design and develop innovative solutions and algorithms that leverage the LEO infrastructure to enhance navigation and integrity performance across various safety-critical user domains (including aviation, automotive, UAV, etc.). Objective 2: to develop and deliver an end-to-end (E2E) software (SW) simulator that will allow to assess, for each MYLE-GNSS Scenario, the integrity performance of the target Services (ARAIM, SBAS, HAS, etc.) with respect to the target User Domain and related application. Objective 3: to conduct an extensive simulation testing campaign and a Proof-of-Concept (PoC) of the MYLE-GNSS implementation in order to validate navigation and integrity performance in support to the different services.

noticeTitle: Belgium – Research and development consultancy services – Fused PNT Analyses based on European Infrastructure
procedureTitle: Fused PNT Analyses based on European Infrastructure
description: The European Commission is launching a study on the potential use of communication-oriented LEO constellations for the deployment of a complementary PNT service. This approach is normally referred to as Fused PNT. This tender will focus on developing a user terminal prototype and a simulated environment enabling to assess the performance of Fused PNT under a realistic set of propagation conditions and inter-satellite interference. In this procurement, the main goals of the European Commission are: • To develop a software receiver, supporting acquisition and tracking of 3GPP reference signals for Non-terrestrial networks (NTN) • To model multipath channel and intersatellite interference, in order to test the software receiver under the realistic satellite based propagation channel and interferences; • To consolidate and complement the part of the E2E emulator, by adding multipath and intersatellite interference models; • To demonstrate the performance of fused PNT ranging in a representative simulated environment • To validate the acquisition and tracking performance in realistic environment.

noticeTitle: Belgium – Research and experimental development services – EU integrated Multi-constellation and Multi-sensor Radio Frequency Interference Monitoring system - M2RFI, GNSS
procedureTitle: EU integrated Multi-constellation and Multi-sensor Radio Frequency Interference Monitoring system - M2RFI, GNSS
description: This project aims to explore the concept of diversifying RF Interference (RFI) monitoring beyond sole reliance on a single space-based infrastructure or sensor type, instead leveraging the potential of accessing and combining multiple satellite constellations and diverse data from heterogeneous data sources. Integrating multiple space-based systems could be a cost-effective alternative to deploying a large constellation of satellites, which would be required to achieve high resolution and widespread coverage. The primary outcome of the project will be the definition of an optimal algorithm, tailored to specific use cases, which will aggregate and processing diverse input RFI data and best comply to mission requirements.

noticeTitle: Belgium – Research and development consultancy services – Fused PNT Analyses based on European Infrastructure
procedureTitle: Fused PNT Analyses based on European Infrastructure
description: The European Commission is launching a study on the potential use of communication-oriented LEO constellations for the deployment of a complementary PNT service. This approach is normally referred to as Fused PNT. This tender will focus on developing a user terminal prototype and a simulated environment enabling to assess the performance of Fused PNT under a realistic set of propagation conditions and inter-satellite interference. In this procurement, the main goals of the European Commission are: • To develop a software receiver, supporting acquisition and tracking of 3GPP reference signals for Non-terrestrial networks (NTN) • To model multipath channel and intersatellite interference, in order to test the software receiver under the realistic satellite based propagation channel and interferences; • To consolidate and complement the part of the E2E emulator, by adding multipath and intersatellite interference models; • To demonstrate the performance of fused PNT ranging in a representative simulated environment • To validate the acquisition and tracking performance in realistic environment.

noticeTitle: Belgium – Research and development consultancy services – Fused PNT Analyses based on European Infrastructure
procedureTitle: Fused PNT Analyses based on European Infrastructure
description: The European Commission is launching a study on the potential use of communication-oriented LEO constellations for the deployment of a complementary PNT service. This approach is normally referred to as Fused PNT. This tender will focus on developing a user terminal prototype and a simulated environment enabling to assess the performance of Fused PNT under a realistic set of propagation conditions and inter-satellite interference. In this procurement, the main goals of the European Commission are: • To develop a software receiver, supporting acquisition and tracking of 3GPP reference signals for Non-terrestrial networks (NTN) • To model multipath channel and intersatellite interference, in order to test the software receiver under the realistic satellite based propagation channel and interferences; • To consolidate and complement the part of the E2E emulator, by adding multipath and intersatellite interference models; • To demonstrate the performance of fused PNT ranging in a representative simulated environment • To validate the acquisition and tracking performance in realistic environment.

noticeTitle: Belgium – Satellite-related communications equipment – Preliminary Market Consultation on satellite communication user terminals
procedureTitle: Preliminary Market Consultation on satellite communication user terminals
description: The objective of the Preliminary Market Consultation (PMC) on satellite communication user terminals is to collect more information from market players, on the current and future capabilities of industry, for the development of user terminals that can be used with communication satellite systems. The consultation was prepared jointly by the European Commission, the European Space Agency and the European Union Agency for the Space Programme. Interested entities and market players active in the design and production of satellite communication terminals, and/ or related activities (i.e. supply chains, services, satellite manufacturers, etc.) are invited to provide feedback to this consultation. The Preliminary Market Consultation is accessible via the EUsurvey web application and it includes two questionnaires: 1. one questionnaire on radiofrequency user terminals: https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/runner/PMC-RF_terminals 2. one questionnaire on optical user terminals : https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/runner/PMC-OPT_terminals Responders may reply to one, or both questionnaires. Feedback and contributions will be accepted in English. Commercial in confidence information from the addressees will be protected upon request and may be subject to the signature of a nondisclosure agreement (NDA).

noticeTitle: Belgium – Research and development services and related consultancy services – MultilaYer LEO Extended GNSS (MYLE-GNSS) end-to-end simulator supporting multi-service integrity analysis
procedureTitle: MultilaYer LEO Extended GNSS (MYLE-GNSS) end-to-end simulator supporting multi-service integrity analysis
description: Objective 1: to design and develop innovative solutions and algorithms that leverage the LEO infrastructure to enhance navigation and integrity performance across various safety-critical user domains (including aviation, automotive, UAV, etc.). Objective 2: to develop and deliver an end-to-end (E2E) software (SW) simulator that will allow to assess, for each MYLE-GNSS Scenario, the integrity performance of the target Services (ARAIM, SBAS, HAS, etc.) with respect to the target User Domain and related application. Objective 3: to conduct an extensive simulation testing campaign and a Proof-of-Concept (PoC) of the MYLE-GNSS implementation in order to validate navigation and integrity performance in support to the different services.

noticeTitle: Belgium – Specialist training services – Pilot project EU space data and services in support of the EU disaster resilience goals
procedureTitle: Pilot project EU space data and services in support of the EU disaster resilience goals
description: This pilot project will deliver live trainings on the use of EU space data for disaster management in 4 locations within EU, via webinars and in bilateral discussions with MS. It will also organize and lead simulation exercises demonstrating the combined used of EU space data and services in crisis situations. Finally, it will be used to assist MS integrate the new Galileo-based alert service in national alert systems. The project has also a component of desktop research and reports drafting on specific questions asked by the contracting authority.

procedureTitle: Pilot project for Search and Rescue operations for Maritime and Aviation (Remote Beacon Activation evolution based on RLS)
description: The pilot project aims to prepare the market for the adoption of the Galileo Beacon Command service by performing activities such as consolidating user requirements, analyzing technical barriers, and prototyping beacons. Other activities include standardization and certification, training, demonstrations, dissemination, and creating an advisory group. The goal is to ensure a correct operation and overcome challenges for the remote activation/deactivation of beacons using the Galileo return link message.

noticeTitle: Belgium – Research and development consultancy services – EGNSS for Unmanned Aircraft System
procedureTitle: EGNSS for Unmanned Aircraft System
description: The aim is to progress in the implementation of the roadmap of the ESU (EGNSS Service for UAS), in particular focusing on the Phase 2 – support to mid-end operations on the basis of previous Commission activities for the definition of the Service for UAS. This contract will help European Commission in achieving its objectives to support the development of a EGNSS (i.e., EGNOS and Galileo) Service for the UAS, in particular the version 1.0 of the service enabling SAIL III operations requiring a high-performant positioning and timing service not only for navigation but additionally for other U-Space services.

noticeTitle: Belgium – Research and development consultancy services – GNSS RFI on-board
procedureTitle: GNSS RFI on-board
description: The subject of this call for tenders is to demonstrate the feasibility of implementing the most promising and mature On-board Resilience Techniques against GNSS Frequency Jamming and Spoofing in a GNSS Receiver Prototype or Demonstrator (hardware and/or software). The objective is to get this Receiver Prototype/Demonstrator to, as a minimum, a Technology Readiness Level of TRL4 (technology validated in lab) or TRL5 (technology validated in relevant environment) , or higher if possible, taking into account the state of the art in the science and applications of navigation. Additionally, it is also an objective to perform some technological studies to better support future developments: Assess which are the optimal complementary technologies depending on the domain; Assess the GNSS receiver behaviour in the presence of an RFI event and Assess the possibility of including the results of the implementation of the On-board GNSS Resilience Techniques in a real receiver.

noticeTitle: Belgium – Design and execution of research and development – Support to NORM data analysis and exploitation
procedureTitle: Support to NORM data analysis and exploitation
description: This is a procurement for acquiring an analytical and processing platform dedicated to the exploitation of the NORM data. The outcome of the project is to develop and deliver a flexible and modular platform capable to ingest and process space radiation data, and in particular that from the NORM instrument that is transferred from Norway to JRC, and to ensure continuous exploitation of this data flow. The project will also be useful for DEFIS to promote its action on space weather and space radiation.

noticeTitle: Belgium, Czechia – Research and development services and related consultancy services – Provision of support services to the European Union Agency for the Space Programme and the European Commission
procedureTitle: Provision of support services to the European Union Agency for the Space Programme and the European Commission
description: Open procedure for provision of support services to the European Union Agency for the Space Programme (EUSPA) and the European Commission (EC) in a number of different areas and locations. Precisely, the foregoing procedure is split into five distinctive lots as follows: Lot 1 – Mission, Services Engineering and Uptake Support, Lot 2 – Ground and Space Segments Engineering Support, Lot 3 – Security- Cyber and Risk Analysis Support, Lot 4 – Project Management & Quality Support, Lot 5 – Operations and Service Provision and Management Support. All lots are envisaged as interinstitutional contracts whereby EUSPA and the European Commission will be co-contracting authorities. The services are envisaged to be performed accordingly at the following indicative locations: Lot 1 - EUSPA HQ in Prague, Galileo Reference Centre in Noordwijk (NL), EUSPA office in Toulouse (FR), European Commission in Brussels, Contractor’s premises; Lot 2 – EUSPA HQ in Prague, Galileo Security Monitoring Centre France and Galileo Security Monitoring Centre Spain, Galileo Service Centre in Madrid (ES), EUSPA office in Toulouse (FR), European Commission in Brussels, Contractor’s premises and other location still to be decided; Lot 3 - EUSPA HQ in Prague, Galileo Security Monitoring Centre France and Galileo Security Monitoring Centre Spain, EUSPA office in Toulouse (FR), European Commission in Brussels, Contractor’s premises (with the possibility to extend performance of services under Lot 3 to the locations, such as Galileo Reference Centre in Noordwijk (NL) and Galileo Service Centre in Madrid (ES)); Lot 4 - EUSPA HQ in Prague, Galileo Control Centres in Germany and Italy, Galileo Service Centre in Madrid (ES), Galileo Security Monitoring Centre France and Galileo Security Monitoring Centre Spain, EUSPA office in Toulouse (FR), European Commission in Brussels, Contractor’s premises; Lot 5 - EUSPA HQ in Prague, Galileo Control Centres in Germany and Italy, Galileo Service Centre in Madrid (ES), Galileo Reference Centre in Noordwijk (NL), Galileo Security Monitoring Centre France and Galileo Security Monitoring Centre Spain, EUSPA office in Toulouse (FR), European Commission in Brussels, Contractor’s premises. These tasks are meant to support Contracting Authorities in discharging their respective roles in the implementation of the EU Space Programme Components and for the execution of future tasks that may be entrusted in relation to other EU Space Programmes, such as the IRIS2.

noticeTitle: Belgium – Research and development consultancy services – GNSS RFI on-board
procedureTitle: GNSS RFI on-board
description: The subject of this call for tenders is to demonstrate the feasibility of implementing the most promising and mature On-board Resilience Techniques against GNSS Frequency Jamming and Spoofing in a GNSS Receiver Prototype or Demonstrator (hardware and/or software). The objective is to get this Receiver Prototype/Demonstrator to, as a minimum, a Technology Readiness Level of TRL4 (technology validated in lab) or TRL5 (technology validated in relevant environment) , or higher if possible, taking into account the state of the art in the science and applications of navigation. Additionally, it is also an objective to perform some technological studies to better support future developments: Assess which are the optimal complementary technologies depending on the domain; Assess the GNSS receiver behaviour in the presence of an RFI event and Assess the possibility of including the results of the implementation of the On-board GNSS Resilience Techniques in a real receiver.

noticeTitle: Belgium – Research and development services and related consultancy services – Contribution to Radio-navigation Accuracy and Resilience
procedureTitle: Contribution to Radio-navigation Accuracy and Resilience
description: The main purpose of this project is to develop and optimize a fully functional ACAS (Assisted Commercial Authentication Service) pre-operational receiver and prototype server, with state-of-the-art technology and performance, and its demonstration in an operational environment including real GNSS authentication signals and with a dedicated testing platform. Such a platform has never been developed before and is considered as highly beneficial for ensuring ACAS correct implementation. It includes analysing critical aspects as hardware synchronization, form factor optimization, real-time signal authentication algorithms able to discern, to the extent possible, between natural impairments (e.g., multipath) and targeted interference, or client-server real-time connectivity. These developments contribute not only to adding resilience to satellite navigation but also to increase the accuracy of authenticated positioning. The project also intends to develop an advanced ACAS testing platform.
